data.turoyo: ʕAmmo Išoʕ: E d Məḏyaḏ Salim bə Xoǧa ḥa we w u qaymaqam u malməduri w ḥa tre: ḥrene man aʕḏawiye stəloye məstəloye kətwo aʕḏawiye. Hani mqadriwo man məqqayṣ kibe obe... Hani mqarrəriwo w saymiwo.
data.translation: Uncle Isho: Well, in Midyat Salim be Khoja was one, and the district governor, the finance director, and one or two others, some members, local ones, representatives; there were members. They used to assess who could pay how much... They used to decide and do it.

data.translation: The Muslims seized them; many of them stabbed their bodies with daggers. Whatever they did, to make them declare with their mouths, "We have become Muslims," they did not declare it.

data.turoyo: Ǧan: ʕAmmo Išoʕ d əmmina hatu ʕabəritu l Xalq Partisi, ʕabəritu bəṯər l Demoqraṭ Partisi. Yaʕni d əmmina hat i naqqa qamayto d mqararlox l ruḥox: "əno gəd ʕubarno li siyase." Mən we d ṭrele d ʕəbrət?
data.translation: Jan: Uncle Isho, as we said, you joined the Halk Party; you joined it after the Democrat Party. That is, as we said, when you first decided for yourself, 'I will enter politics,' what was it that led you to enter?
